findings.description: The root AGENTS.md still carries the repository's language and spelling directive.
findings.analysis: Requirement 5 moves language, spelling locale, and accepted terminology to the project overlay so reusable skills do not rely on a root AGENTS.md instruction. Leaving the existing directive creates two potential sources of truth.
findings.recommendation: Remove the language directive from the root AGENTS.md and retain the established policy solely in .agents/project/language.md.
findings.rationale: Language and spelling preferences vary by project, so this repository's guidance belongs only in its project overlay.
